Open the TEST registration page; enter your own permanent email and a strong password; submit once.
Account is created without staff privileges; email-verification screen appears; no portfolio access is granted before proof.
Register with a consenting tester mailbox different from the organiser's; check Inbox and Spam; record arrival time.
The intended mailbox receives its own verification link; mail is not redirected to the organiser and contains the TEST destination.
Open the verification link; explicitly confirm; sign in if requested; open Get Started.
Email becomes verified; workspace setup is accessible; confirmation does not bypass password or MFA.
Try blank fields, invalid email, mismatched passwords and a weak password on registration.
Clear field errors prevent account creation; entered safe fields remain available for correction.
Try registering an existing email and an obvious disposable address; do not create repeated requests.
No duplicate account or extra privilege is created; safe explanatory errors are shown.
Use a previously consumed link; ask the organiser for a deliberately expired test link.
The link cannot verify again; the interface offers a safe way to sign in and request a fresh link.
Request verification again immediately, then after the displayed cooldown.
Immediate repeats are limited; a later request works; stale links cannot replace current mailbox ownership.
Sign in with correct credentials; sign out; use Back and refresh on a private page.
Correct login enters the right account; signed-out users cannot reopen private data.
Try one incorrect password; request a password reset for your mailbox; complete it; retry the old password.
Bad credentials fail; reset mail reaches your inbox; the new password works and the old one fails.
Request recovery for an organiser-approved unused address.
The response does not reveal whether an account exists and does not sign anyone in.
In Security, scan the QR privately; confirm with your authenticator; sign out and back in.
Enrollment requires a valid code; login requires the password and authenticator; invalid codes do not open the account.
Edit your profile; refresh; change email only on a disposable test account and verify the new mailbox.
Allowed profile edits persist; changed email loses its old verification proof; affected WhatsApp access requires reconnection.
After mailbox verification, create a fictional workspace and select its currency/time zone.
One workspace is created; owner access is correct; refresh preserves the setup state.
Follow setup to add a property and unit with required fields; continue to the checklist.
Property and unit appear once; required checklist steps update and links open the appropriate modules.
Leave a required setup field empty; correct it; go back, refresh and resume.
Errors identify the missing field; valid progress is retained without duplicate records.
View the WhatsApp section without connecting; continue required setup steps.
WhatsApp is labelled optional, notice consent starts unchecked, and required setup can finish without it.
Add the tenant, lease and invoice requested by the checklist; return to Get Started.
Completed steps reflect saved records; completed setup does not repeatedly send the user through first-property setup.
Sign in to a new account, navigate modules and refresh on mobile and desktop.
No automatic tour overlay or tour launcher obstructs this alpha; normal setup remains usable.
Create a uniquely prefixed property; return to the list; search and reopen it.
Saved details and counts are correct and remain after refresh.
Edit permitted details and save; open again, make another change and cancel.
Saved changes persist; cancelled changes do not alter the record.
Create two uniquely named units with different rent values in the same property.
Each unit belongs to the intended property and displays the correct rent, currency and status.
Try missing required fields, invalid rent and a duplicate unit identifier where uniqueness is required.
Invalid values are rejected clearly and no partial or duplicate unit is created.
Search by a known value; filter status; search for a nonexistent value; clear filters.
The intended rows appear; empty results are understandable; clearing filters restores records.
Activate a tenancy in one unit and compare property/unit occupancy and dashboard counts.
The linked unit's occupancy is consistent; the second unit remains vacant.
Use a disposable vacant record; test archive/unarchive if offered; try removing a record with live dependencies.
Supported archive actions are reversible; linked tenancy/financial history is protected and errors explain restrictions.
If the property screen exposes owner/contact or attachments, add fictional details and a harmless file; reopen.
Only supported fields are offered; saved data/files remain associated with the correct property.
Add a fictional tenant using a consenting participant's email and phone; fill required billing details.
A single tenant record saves with correct contact and billing details.
Try malformed email/phone, missing names and invalid identifier formats; correct them.
Errors are specific; correction works; invalid data does not silently become usable.
Invite the paired tenant's own mailbox from the tenant record; record message arrival.
Invitation is sent to the intended mailbox and references the correct workspace; the manager sees its state.
Open the invitation in a signed-out/private browser; choose a password and accept.
The tenant account is created through the invitation, mailbox ownership is established, and only the intended tenancy is linked.
Accept an invitation as an existing eligible tenant account; try once while signed in as a different email.
The matching account can accept; the wrong account cannot acquire the invitation or have its password replaced.
Revoke an unused invitation; try its old link; test a previously accepted link.
Revoked/consumed links cannot create another membership; a fresh authorised invitation follows the normal process.
Search/filter tenants; reopen a profile and inspect linked lease, invoice and repair records.
Only matching workspace records appear and history links refer to the correct tenant.
On an organiser-approved disposable tenant, remove the last active tenancy/access link; refresh the portal and use its WhatsApp menu.
The former tenant loses private tenancy actions; removal is explained; old links/chat actions do not preserve access.
If Import is exposed, use a small current-format sample with one valid and one invalid row; preview before saving.
Mapping, errors and atomic/partial-save policy are clear; no unintended duplicates or financial history are created.
Select the intended property, unit and tenant; enter full-month terms and dates; activate using the normal process.
The saved lease links the correct records and active status, rent, dates and occupancy agree.
Try an end date before the start, invalid rent and an overlapping active tenancy where prohibited.
Invalid or conflicting terms are rejected; no half-created active lease remains.
Edit a draft; cancel unsaved changes; save a permitted edit and reopen.
Draft/active edit rules are clear and only saved changes persist.
Complete required fictional issuer/tenant details; preview and download the lease.
The document opens and shows correct parties, unit, rent, dates and pages without clipped text.
Invitation to sign a test lease
Send the paired participant a signing invitation; open the link on phone; review and use a test signature.
Only the intended document can be signed; required confirmations are clear and completion is reflected on both sides.
Try incomplete signature input; use a completed or organiser-revoked link again.
Incomplete input is blocked and old links cannot modify completed signing evidence.
Open My lease and the completed document in the portal; compare against the manager's lease.
Only the tenant's linked lease and authorised files appear with consistent terms and signature state.
Use a separate test lease for deposit/paid-ahead fields where offered; compare the statement and billed-from date.
The UI explains each value; deposit/prepaid facts do not silently become rent income or duplicate opening debt.
For an active full-month lease, generate the selected month's invoice once.
One invoice appears for the correct tenant, unit, period, rent and due date.
Repeat invoice generation for the same lease and period; refresh the list.
No duplicate live rent invoice or double charge is created.
Create a manual invoice with test lines; try invalid quantities/amounts and missing required fields first.
Invalid input is blocked; valid lines total correctly using the displayed rounding and currency.
Search reference/tenant, filter status/property/period and clear filters.
Results and displayed totals match the selected scope; clearing filters restores the list.
Open a saved invoice as manager and as its tenant; compare reference, dates, amount and balance.
Both see the same authorised invoice facts; tenant controls match tenant permissions.
On a separate incomplete fictional tenant, request the invoice PDF before adding TPIN/billing address.
The application identifies missing details and directs correction; it does not create a misleading final PDF.
Complete required test issuer/tenant details, retry the PDF and compare both accounts' copies.
The PDF renders with the correct invoice data; no unrelated tenant facts or public private-file URL is exposed.
For a separate existing tenancy, record K500 opening debt; generate a K2,500 full-month invoice; open the statement.
Outstanding debt is K3,000 before payments; opening debt remains distinct from current-month billed rent.
Correct or void an unpaid test invoice
Use the supported correction/void action with any required reason; revisit totals and statement.
The audit/history remains, the invoice cannot be paid as live debt, and totals reflect the correction once.
On a manually settled test invoice, try an action that would erase payment history or create an invalid balance.
The application requires the supported correction path and preserves financial evidence.
Open tenant payment controls and WhatsApp Pay rent; inspect any exposed collection/withdrawal action without entering bank credentials.
Online payment initiation and payouts are unavailable; no external payment prompt, debit or transfer starts.
Print/Save PDF an invoice with a long fictional name/address and multiple lines on desktop and phone.
All pages are readable, totals are visible, and navigation controls are excluded from the printed document.
Start with an isolated unpaid K2,500 invoice; record a K1,000 test payment with date/method/reference.
Balance becomes K1,500, status becomes partial, and one numbered receipt/history entry is created.
Record the remaining K1,500 on that invoice; compare tenant view and report.
Balance becomes zero and settled status/receipts agree across the application.
Try zero, negative and excessive amounts; double-click one valid save on a disposable invoice.
Invalid financial input is rejected; the UI/server prevent an unintended duplicate or unexplained overpayment.
Use the supported reversal with a clear reason; reopen receipt, invoice and statement.
History remains with reversal evidence; the exact balance is restored once; no real refund occurs.
Choose I've already paid; use a dummy payment reference and clearly labelled fake proof file; submit once.
Report is pending review, visible to the correct manager, and does not mark the invoice paid before confirmation.
Manager reviews the tenant's dummy evidence and confirms once; both accounts refresh.
A single manual payment and receipt are created for the confirmed amount; report and invoice states agree.
Manager asks for details with a reason; tenant edits and resubmits the same report.
Tenant sees the question; correction remains associated with the original report and does not create duplicate money records.
Manager uses the supported not-received/rejection action with a reason on a fresh dummy report.
Tenant sees the outcome/reason; no payment or receipt is falsely created.
Submit a disposable report and cancel it before manager confirmation; refresh both views.
Cancellation is reflected on both sides and a cancelled report cannot later be confirmed through an old action.
Open the authorised receipt/proof; try its link while signed out and from the organiser's second dummy workspace.
Authorised viewing works; unrelated or signed-out users cannot retrieve the private evidence.
Open Rent roll with one leased and one vacant test unit; compare rent/occupancy against Properties.
Rows, occupancy, rent values and property filters agree with the underlying records.
Use a deliberately overdue unpaid test invoice; inspect ageing and open its source record.
Debt and ageing follow its due date; property/tenant links reach the correct record.
Filter Collections to the dates/property of a manual test receipt and its reversal.
Recorded amounts, reversals and totals agree; pending proof is not counted as paid.
Manager opens the tenant statement; tenant opens their Statement; compare the same date range.
Charges, payments, reversals and closing balance agree exactly for that tenant.
View a statement including separate opening debt, current rent, a deposit and a simulated payment.
Each category is labelled correctly; opening debt is not counted twice or presented as current billed rent.
Change each supported filter and reset; select a range with no entries.
Every row/total follows the active filters; empty state is clear and stale previous results are not retained.
Export a filtered CSV and any offered statement PDF; compare row count, dates and totals to the screen.
The full authorised filtered dataset is exported with readable headings and no foreign tenant/workspace records.
Use several test records and next/previous pages; open a source invoice from the report and return.
No skipped/repeated records are apparent; selected report and filters remain understandable.
Create a clear fictional repair with category/priority/location and description.
One request is created for the correct tenancy; the manager sees it and the tenant can reopen it.
Attach a small permitted image at the supported stage; reopen from both accounts.
The correct request retains its image and authorised users can view it.
Try blank required repair details, an unsupported file and an over-limit file using harmless samples.
The interface explains constraints; no empty request or unintended upload is accepted.
Assign responsibility/vendor where offered; move the request through supported progress states.
Changes persist and the correct tenant sees the public progress; dashboard counts update consistently.
Exchange tenant-visible comments; add an internal manager comment where supported.
Public comments reach the intended participants; internal comments remain hidden from tenants.
Complete a disposable request; reopen using the supported action; compare both sides.
Status, timestamps, history and Needs attention reflect each transition without duplicate requests.
Create a fictional vendor if offered; assign it; filter open/closed/priority requests and clear filters.
Vendor and filters apply to the intended workspace/request and no unrelated rows appear.
As the paired second tenant, use an organiser-provided link to another dummy tenant's repair.
The other tenant's description, comments and images are denied without exposing private details.
Trigger a relevant test invoice/repair update; inspect the bell; mark it read; compare another account.
The intended account sees its own update; reading it does not mark another person's notification read.
Create one new invoice for a consenting tenant; inspect its intended mailbox and delivery history.
The correct participant receives the right invoice facts; sent/failed/held status reflects the actual attempt.
Create a new repair/progress event and send a test lease for signing; check the intended recipients.
Relevant operational mail reaches the correct consenting participants with the correct TEST links.
Change personal optional preferences; trigger a harmless new event; inspect in-app and email behaviour.
Optional choices persist; required account/operational email is not falsely represented as optional marketing.
Use a small notice to one consenting test tenant; inspect pending/review/sent history for the workflow exposed to the role.
The selected audience and delivery state are clear; repeated clicks do not create unintended duplicate sends.
Open verification, invitation, reset and document links received during the exercise.
Each link stays in the intended TEST flow; it does not send the participant into production or another account.
Use an email-verified account and a real consenting number outside the original operator list; connect via the exact prefilled CONNECT message.
The intended number connects after signed inbound proof and website confirmation, with the correct personal role.
Select I've sent the message before sending; then send from a different consenting test number.
The website remains pending; the unproven/wrong number cannot acquire the account binding.
Let a disposable challenge expire; start again; try the old message, then the new one; disconnect afterwards.
Old challenges cannot connect; the current number can connect; disconnect removes action access and optional notices.
Send MENU after connecting; compare manager and tenant options; choose supported actions using buttons/lists.
The menu reflects the current role/workspace and private information is scoped to the connected identity.
Request an existing complete test invoice through the correct menu; open the received document.
The intended invoice PDF arrives and is readable; record handset arrival separately from server acceptance.
Request the current-month statement and an available test receipt; compare with website copies.
Documents reach the intended handset with matching authorised records and balances.
Start a repair through the menu; supply fields in order; attach a permitted photo when requested; confirm.
One request with the intended details/photo appears on the website; no request is submitted before confirmation.
Choose one consenting overdue test tenant; preview the reminder; cancel once, then start again and confirm.
Preview/cancel sends nothing; confirmation queues one scoped reminder and delivery respects consent and quiet hours.
Tenant follows the payment-proof menu with dummy evidence; manager reviews the message and confirms once.
A pending report precedes approval; one manual payment/receipt follows confirmation; correct participants see the result.
Use fresh dummy reports to ask for details, resubmit and reject using the supported reviewer actions.
Reasons/states match the website; stale buttons cannot duplicate or override a completed decision.
Connect with notices off; inspect consent; opt in through the supported flow; send STOP and try an old private action.
Connection alone does not grant proactive-notice consent; STOP revokes access/consent and stale actions are denied.
MENU, BACK, CANCEL and random input
Enter a guided draft; use BACK/CANCEL/MENU; send unrelated text and a harmless unsolicited attachment.
Navigation is understandable, drafts do not submit accidentally, and unsolicited content does not create a payment or repair.
On an organiser-controlled account, remove its access or change its verified identity; press an old menu/reviewer button.
Permissions are rechecked and old private actions do not survive revoked access or identity changes.
Choose Create invoice in Dwella and Pay rent if shown.
Invoice creation opens the website; online money movement is unavailable during this exercise.
Compare counts, outstanding debt and Needs attention before/after a test invoice, manual payment and repair update.
Summary values agree with source records; a resolved item does not remain counted as unresolved.
Update permitted profile fields and theme; refresh and reopen on phone.
Saved account/theme choices persist and long text remains readable.
Change a permitted fictional workspace field; compare as tenant or a restricted collaborator if provided.
Only authorised roles can change workspace settings; other users do not gain controls through a direct URL.
Open Notifications; inspect connection, consent and channel availability.
WhatsApp state is accurate; SMS is not presented as working; save-preferences feedback does not imply a message was sent.
Open module submenu links and a saved authorised detail link; use Back and refresh.
The correct section is selected and the appropriate record/page is restored without losing role context.
Use two organiser-approved dummy workspaces; try the other workspace's known property, tenant, invoice and report links.
Foreign data/actions are denied; search, counts, exports and errors do not reveal private records.
Try direct manager/admin URLs and another dummy tenant's invoice, lease, statement and document links.
The tenant sees only their own permitted records and cannot create manager/admin access.
Open the same disposable form/report in two tabs; save once; refresh the other tab and repeat only the intended action.
Current state is clear; duplicate submissions do not silently duplicate critical records.
With an organiser-approved disposable draft, disconnect your network briefly, submit, reconnect and retry carefully.
Failure feedback is actionable; the application does not claim a save that failed or create duplicates on recovery.
Run a main journey at phone width and on desktop using Tab/Enter/Escape; inspect drawers, errors and PDF actions.
Primary controls are reachable, labels/errors are readable, focus is usable and there is no horizontal page overflow.
Use an empty account, a slow connection and long fictional record names; inspect list/detail screens.
Loading/empty/error states are distinct and long content does not hide controls or misrepresent old data as fresh.
Check TEST server capabilities and attempt a synthetic collection/payout request through the approved internal test procedure.
Collections, payouts and automatic payout flags are off; server rejects initiation and no provider charge/transfer call occurs.
Complete one genuine manager registration, verification, tenant invitation and WhatsApp connection using consenting participant accounts.
End-to-end inbox/handset evidence exists before the wider invitation; no public access to production/admin is granted.
Sign in as administrator with MFA; enter an approved test workspace support context; leave it.
MFA is enforced; support context and actions are audited; leaving context removes workspace access as designed.
Inspect test users/workspaces; suspend and restore a disposable workspace; compare manager/tenant access.
Only administrators can perform the action; suspended access is blocked and restoration follows the intended rules.
If identity checks are enabled, use a clearly artificial sample under organiser control; inspect reviewer-only access.
Status/reasons are accurate; private evidence is unavailable through public media or unrelated accounts.
Check worker heartbeats, failed/held/review messages, sender quota and latest successful backup during the test window.
Problems can be detected and assigned; provider acceptance is distinguished from inbox/handset delivery; backups remain current.
Review a sample create/update/reversal/access audit trail; confirm SMS, gateway payments, outreach blasts and guided tour remain excluded.
Important actions are traceable; no excluded live action is accidentally enabled; every Critical/High finding has an owner.
If the organiser explicitly includes an enabled assistant or additional visible module, assign a bounded case before use.
Optional features use current role/workspace permissions and have documented expectations; unassigned roadmap features are not marked passed.
